rationale: IPX Power is the distinct grid-tied solar and storage platform created when Google's March 10, 2026 Intersect acquisition excluded the California/Texas grid-tied portfolio. CAI directly owns IPX through Climate Adaptive Infrastructure Fund LP, an explicit infrastructure vehicle, so IPX remains in scope. TPG Rise Climate is climate private equity and Greenbelt's applicable vehicle lacks a proven infrastructure mandate; those owner periods remain factual but are excluded from the infrastructure census.
recommendedChanges: Retain one active IPX Power canonical record through CAI's qualifying infrastructure-fund ownership.
Record TPG Rise Climate as the factual active majority owner but exclude its owner period from the infrastructure census.
Add Greenbelt as a factual active minority owner but exclude its period absent vehicle-specific infrastructure-mandate evidence.
Use IPX Power, LLC as the public legal name while retaining IPX Power USA, LLC as a related legal alias until the ultimate chain is disclosed.
Limit the platform boundary to Intersect's carved-out California/Texas grid-tied solar and storage portfolio; exclude Google's digital-power business and keep individual projects beneath IPX.
Record March 10, 2026 as the IPX launch and owner entry date, and preserve the August 6, 2026 financing as continuing-status evidence rather than an ownership transaction.
unresolvedQuestions: The ultimate entity and project-SPV chain is not publicly disclosed.
Exact sponsor percentages, securities, consideration, rollover/new-money allocation and governance are not publicly disclosed.
The exact TPG and Greenbelt funds or SPVs and Greenbelt vehicle mandate are not publicly disclosed.
Project-level PPAs and offtakers are not fully public.
